player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round of IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Each round, guess a number between {min_guess} and {max_guess}.
After both guesses, the target is (2/3)x(average of both guesses),
and the player whose guess is closest to the target wins that round.
Reply with your guess in the format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format de'na valid; tolong kirim pakkutana mu sebagai [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Naiyya pakkitanna parellu ri pallawangenna {min_guess} nenniyya {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Pamain 0 mangkene {guess0}; Pamain 1 mangkene {guess1}. Dengan demikian Targetnya adalah: {target}.
